name: Prism-TS-TW
title: Prism
description: A WebGL shader draws a luminous prism outline on black. It rotates and wobbles, with pale blue-white edges and faint teal and rust colour shifting inside, made to sit behind page content.
use: A dark hero or section needs a slow ambient object glowing behind the headline.
avoid: It renders continuously on the GPU, so it costs battery and is louder than a flat gradient.
a11y: A pure canvas effect with no content to label, and it ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A luminous triangular outline sits in the middle of a black stage, its edges thick and soft like light through glass. The base glows white-blue while the inside carries faint teal and rust tones.
behaves: The whole prism wobbles and turns slowly, its edges and inner colours sliding as the shape moves. In this clip it keeps drifting on its own and never settles.
customise: Shape, animation mode, glow, noise, bloom, hue shift, scale and transparency are props; the shader's look itself needs a source edit.
weight: heavy: A fragment shader ray-marches up to 100 steps every frame.
